[[Gøta]], [[Faroe Islands]] | capacity = 1,600 (440 seated) | chairman = Brandur Jacobsen | manager = Jóhan Petur Poulsen | league = [[Faroe Islands Premier League]] | season = [[2025 Faroe Islands Premier League|2025]] | position = Faroe Islands Premier League, 4th of 10 | website = {{URL|http://www.vikingur.fo/}} | pattern_la1 = | pattern_b1 = _vikingur24h | pattern_ra1 = | pattern_sh1 = _vikingur24h | pattern_so1 = _vikingur1819h | leftarm1 = 83BEF4 | body1 = 83BEF4 | rightarm1 = 83BEF4 | shorts1 = 000000 | socks1 = 83BEF4 | pattern_la2 = _adidasicon25ub | pattern_b2 = _wislap2526a | pattern_ra2 = _adidasicon25ub | pattern_sh2 = _adidastiro24wb | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = 000000 | body2 = 000000 | rightarm2 = 000000 | shorts2 = FFFFFF | socks2 = FFFFFF }} '''Víkingur''' is a [[Faroe Islands|Faroese]] professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Leirvík]]. The club was founded in 2008 after the merger of [[GÍ Gøta]] and [[Leirvík ÍF]].[http://www.soccerandequipment.com/january-2008-roundup.html Faroe Islands Soccer News, January 2008 Round-Up] They play at the [[Sarpugerði|Sarpugerði Stadium]] in [[Norðragøta]]. Both villages are part of the same municipality [[Eysturkommuna]], located on the island of [[Eysturoy]] and about 5 kilometers away from each other. The club won the Faroese championship for the first time in the 2016 season.{{cite web|url=http://www.in.fo/news-detail/vikingur-skrivar-soegu-a-argjum/|title=Víkingur skrivar søgu á Argjum|last=Hansen|first=Jóannes|date=22 October 2016|publisher=In.fo|language=fo|access-date=22 October 2016|archive-date=9 August 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170809173722/http://www.in.fo/news-detail/vikingur-skrivar-soegu-a-argjum/|url-status=dead}} In the 2017 season, Vikingur won the championship again."}}
